system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes in dressing-gown and slippers, leaning back in his armchair, with Dr. Watson in tweed seated across from him by the fire","action":"Holmes reclines with his pipe while Watson leans forward attentively; both turn startled toward the door as a towering figure, Dr. Roylott, bursts in","setting":"221B Baker Street sitting room, cluttered with papers, pipe smoke hanging in the air, violin on a chair, the room's door flung open","secondaryElements":"Overcast grey morning light through the window mixed with a dim coal fire and one oil lamp; a scattered breakfast table; a folded newspaper","mood":"Tense, sinister surprise with dry restraint and gaslit intimacy","timeOfDay":"Morning, overcast","composition":"Single wide interior shot from across the room, Holmes and Watson in the foreground by the hearth, the doorway and intruding figure framed at the right, the window light falling across the papers"}
